svg.text: All three treatments at all three strengths
The bottom 300 units of the A’s left leg at 1.25x, the A as built in grey underneath. The dashed line is y=200.
Read the middle number: it is the stroke at mid-height, where the A meets the H and the N in a word.
The flare holds 32.9 at every strength — the A as built. Straight goes 37.9, 42.9, 47.9; curved 32.0, 38.0, 44.0.
So only the flare leaves the letter’s colour alone. The other two are progressively heavier A’s that happen to be widest at the foot.
